idea: Lantern children: 14 distinct outfits (hats/hoods/scarves/mittens/skin/height)
Lanterns: round/star/house in 7 colours on a stick; flickering glow
how: tools/bake/lanterns.py; drawn at the tracked left hand

idea: Procession: 4-7 kids in a row across the screen
Groups join in when another group is singing ahead
Sing for St Martin: he listens then gives each singer a sweet; they cheer
Sing for a beggar: one child walks up and gives (sweet / mandarin / apple / present / their lantern left glowing) and skips back
St Martin with cloak in 4 stages (full / half / quarter / none)
Cuts his cloak with his sword and hands the piece to a beggar who wraps it round
No cloak left: sits down in the cold and is a beggar himself; a new St Martin comes for him
Four beggars sit and shiver; wrapped in the red cloth they stand up cheered and walk off
Moon top left; lanterns hanging on a line top right
Church whose door opens: beggars go in; Martin / beggar / rich man / child comes out
how: element 'church' (S.church; tools/bake/church.py): service, come_out; Martin weighted up when the room has none; rich when an element 'rich' exists

idea: Kid leads a beggar to church
how: church fetch: a child holds out a hand, they walk in together; the child comes out again

idea: Procession led by juf/meester with a big lantern on a pole out of a school and back in
how: element 'school' (S.school; tools/bake/school.py building + juf/meester with the kids' clips; lanterns.py pole()): the class files out behind the teacher (the procession element's children; el.teachers/el.poles) and walks the screens (h.cls); a class walking up to a school goes in

idea: Fur coat hat cane: passes beggars nose up; sometimes drops a glinting coin; sung to he pats his pockets
how: tools/bake/rich.py; S.rich (element rich: coin, pocket_coin; S.meet rich); also out of the church

idea: Lantern catches fire: flame / ash / bare stick / a new lantern handed over
how: kid.on_fire (el.fire, per child per screen); lanterns.py burning(), ash(); the nearest friend brings a new lantern (none: the moon may come for the bare stick)

idea: LED lantern dies: a shake and it comes back on
how: carry_led (lanterns.py led()) in the kids' lantern lists; kid.led_dies (el.led_dies, el.led_back: stays dead sometimes - the moon may come)

idea: Doorbell children: houses (3 fronts) - they ring and sing at the door; the door opens and the resident hands out sweets; a grumpy house switches the light off and peeks through the curtain
Kids sing at a cow (de koeien hebben staarten); it swishes and moos back
Sint-Maartensvuur: a bonfire; kids passing gather and sing at it
Two teenagers without lanterns and a big bag at a door: a turnip - or the light goes off; they shrug and slouch off
Geese give him away: he creeps in among them to hide and they all honk at him (the legend)
Utrecht: the Dom tower at dusk in its own shape - two square stages and the open octagonal lantern (St Martin is the city's patron)
Geese flying south in a V
Utrecht flag flying from the Dom's upper gallery

The island story: Columbus's caravel bumps the island (a coconut drops); Columbus plants a flag with St Martin's cloak (11-11-1493); the Frenchman and the Dutchman pop up on either side; Columbus sails off sheepishly; they squabble - St Martin cuts the island in two like his cloak and hands each a half (no St Martin about: a plain sword slice)

The border walk (1648): back to back; the Dutchman drinks jenever and falls asleep; the Frenchman comes round from the other side and plants his flag past the middle; the Dutchman wakes and shrugs; round the room's screens (one screen: off one side and in at the other)
St Martin lays a piece of his cloak over the sleeping Dutchman: he sleeps on
Maho beach: a jet low overhead (rare)
11:11: prince carnaval + jester + two trumpets cross the room once with confetti (os.date)

Outfit looks to choose from: v1 (first try) / A gold cuirass + plumed helmet / B silver + plumed helmet / C bareheaded; all with pteruges bare knees brooch spatha and a cone cloak that shows from the side
Rag beggars after the legend (old bearded man / woman in headscarf / young man in a torn tunic) next to the first try
Unlit lantern (about 1 in 6 kids): meets a lit one; lanterns together and a spark jumps across - both cheer
Lighting gone wrong: POOF - a flare and smoke; both kids sooty with frizzy hair; they blink and laugh
Lighting swap: the lit one goes out as the other lights; it looks at its dark lantern and runs after the other
The moon cycle: a lantern slips off a stick and flies up to become the moon; the moon sinks or flies loose and lands on a lightless child's stick
Rags polish: a real headscarf knotted under the chin; blankets over the shoulders like a cape (a corner over the knees sitting); the old man's crooked stick; a wooden bowl in front while sitting
how: martin.py blanket(), headscarf(), walking_stick(), BOWL, rag_clips()

idea: The cloak wider so it shows beside him from the front
Church and Dom clocks show the real local time (hands their own sprites; buildings always behind the walkers)
how: church_hands/dom_hands (clock_hands in stm_scenery.py); stm_extra X.clock_hands; engine restack (a.backdrop)

idea: The chain: a robed beggar passes one sitting, tears his robe and gives half (it grows whole on the other); half to give once more, then he sits down bare
how: S.beggar chain_give (S.meet chain 0.4); martin.py ROBE/ROBE_V/ROBE_H, chain_clips(); robed beggars hand over to the next screen

idea: The cut H or V at random: V lengthwise (narrower, from one shoulder), H across (shorter: knees, waist, shoulder cape); the stroke matches (chop / sideways slice), the piece handed keeps its shape
how: martin.py CUT_D, cloak_cut(); martin_D_1v/1h/2vv/2hh/2vh, clips cut_v/cut_h; el.cuts; a.path, a.set_stage, a.cut_pick; cloth_v/cloth_h

idea: Sugar-beet lantern: a carved beet with a face hanging from a stick, candle-lit (the old knollen lantern); rare among the paper ones, never catches fire
how: lanterns.py shape beet: carry/stand/unlit/loose_beet; one in each kid lanterns list; candle() leaves it out
